# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_GAP_FADE

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY gaps opposite the opening-range direction (below ORL or above ORH) and then reverts to VWAP within the first three 5-minute bars, a mean-reversion fade back to VWAP offers an edge. This occurs because initial gap momentum often exhausts quickly, and institutional algorithms tend to push price back toward the VWAP as a fair-value reference during early morning liquidity sweeps.

## Mechanism

Define opening range (ORL, ORH) from the first 5-minute bar after 09:30 EST. If open < ORL (gap down) and price closes above VWAP within bars 2-4 (09:35-09:50 EST), go long at the close of the bar that first closes above VWAP. If open > ORH (gap up) and price closes below VWAP within bars 2-4, go short at the close of the bar that first closes below VWAP. Exit: stop at ORH (for longs) or ORL (for shorts) or 0.6% risk (whichever is tighter), TP1 at 1R, runner uses premium-stop of 15% of entry premium. Restrict to VIX < 18 and first 30 minutes after open (09:30-10:00 EST).
